title: ClearPath Tier Deposit Shares for Network and Server Order Approvals
content:
The infrastructure deposit share, the percentage at which the deposit on the approval of a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order quote is taken, is **35.0 percent** for a client whose active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement is on the ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise tier, **40.0 percent** for a client whose active ClearPath agreement is on the ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional tier, and the order type's deposit percentage, 50 percent for both order types, for every other client.

| Client's ClearPath position on the approval day | Infrastructure deposit share |
|---|---|
| Active, ClearPath Premier or ClearPath Enterprise | 35.0 percent |
| Active, ClearPath Standard or ClearPath Professional | 40.0 percent |
| Active, ClearPath Monitor or ClearPath Essentials | 50 percent |
| Agreement in any other status, or no agreement | 50 percent |

The tier and status are read from the client's ClearPath agreement record. On a hypothetical quote total of 10000.00 the three shares correspond to 3500.00, 4000.00 and 5000.00.
